sections.Profile:
"Rocket Ship," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in March 1958, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. The playfield features four flippers, two gobble holes, and a central roto-target.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1958
